context: Tests whether the agent implements UC-010 (Browse Product Catalog) end-to-end following the implement skill: a JPA entity mapped onto the existing schema, a Spring Data JPA repository, a service enforcing BR-010, a REST controller returning a DTO (not the entity), and a React page calling the endpoint. No test files should be created.

checklist.name: Product JPA entity created
checklist.description: A Product class annotated @Entity is created, mapped onto the existing product table (fields for id, name, category, price, inStock matching the migration's columns via default Hibernate naming)

checklist.name: Spring Data JPA repository created
checklist.description: A ProductRepository interface extends JpaRepository (or CrudRepository) for the Product entity

checklist.name: Service class enforces BR-010
checklist.description: A service class contains the query/filter logic that excludes inStock = false products regardless of the category filter applied, matching business rule BR-010

checklist.name: Category filter supported
checklist.description: The backend supports filtering the product list by an optional category parameter, matching alternative flow A1

checklist.name: Controller returns a DTO, not the entity
checklist.description: The @RestController method(s) return a DTO/record type rather than the Product @Entity directly

checklist.name: REST endpoint exposed
checklist.description: A @RestController class exposes a GET endpoint (e.g. under /api/products) returning the product list as JSON

checklist.name: No @Transactional or ddl-auto changes
checklist.description: The implementation does not change spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto away from validate and does not modify the existing Flyway migration

checklist.name: React page fetches from the new endpoint
checklist.description: ProductCatalogPage (or its replacement) calls the new backend endpoint to load products, using fetch or the project's existing API client convention

checklist.name: Category filter dropdown in the UI
checklist.description: The React component renders a category filter control (e.g. a select/dropdown) that narrows the displayed products, matching alternative flow A1

checklist.name: TanStack Query used for server state
checklist.description: The frontend implementation uses useQuery (TanStack Query) to fetch and cache the product list, matching the project's stated existing convention

checklist.name: No test files created
checklist.description: No test classes (Java) or test files (*.test.tsx, *.spec.ts) are created as part of this task
